accuracy: A painted reconstruction by one author: one interpretation among several. Map ages are Scotese's Table 1 ages on the 2008 timescale his atlas uses.
adaptations: Maps: resized from 3600 x 1800 to 1024 x 512 (Lanczos) and re-encoded as WebP quality 65; a 256 x 128 preview of each, combined into one sheet at quality 70. No colors or content changed.
cite: Scotese, C.R., 2016. PALEOMAP PaleoAtlas for GPlates and the PaleoData Plotter Program, PALEOMAP Project. Via Scotese, C.R. & Wright, N.M., 2018, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.5460860.
